text: Output is structured as a test strategy or review with Contract, Priority Properties, and Test Plan sections
Diagnoses the suite as asserting implementation and call order rather than behavior, so it breaks on refactors while missing real defects
Explains why 97% coverage coexisted with both shipped bugs: the tests execute the lines but assert nothing about the outcomes
Connects both shipped bugs to the missing behavioral assertions: no test asserts rejection of a duplicate email or a short password
Specifically flags the hasher-before-repository ordering test as testing an implementation detail with no behavioral meaning
Flags test_create_user_does_not_raise as vacuous, since it asserts nothing and passes on almost any implementation
Proposes concrete replacement tests stated in terms of observable behavior rather than mock call assertions
Names the Beck desiderata at stake, for example that these tests are not behavior-sensitive and not structure-insensitive
